title: Naruto: Shippuden
synopsis:
Naruto: Shippuuden is the continuation of the original animated TV series Naruto. The story revolves around an older and slightly more matured Uzumaki Naruto and his quest to save his friend Uchiha Sasuke from the grips of the snake-like Shinobi, Orochimaru. After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work, though it will not be easy, as he has amassed a few (more dangerous) enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki. 

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.synopsis: A figure passes through the gates. It's an older Naruto, who has returned from a long training journey with Jiraiya. Naruto Uzumaki is back!

episodes.title: The Akatsuki Makes Its Move
episodes.synopsis: Naruto and Sakura team up and challenge Kakashi to a survival challenge to show off their progress.

episodes.title: The Results of Training
episodes.synopsis: Naruto’s and Sakura’s combined skills force Kakashi to use his Sharingan right off the bat. Naruto masterfully unleashes his jutsu one after another.

episodes.title: The Jinchuriki of the Sand
episodes.synopsis: Gaara is quick to detect Deidara’s presence, and an aerial battle ensues with Deidara on his giant bird and Gaara atop sand.

episodes.title: The Kazekage Stands Tall
episodes.synopsis: Naruto and Sakura defeat Kakashi in the survival challenge. Tsunade assigns them to a three-man squad led by Kakashi, who tells them they are now his equals.

episodes.title: Mission Cleared
episodes.synopsis: In order to protect his village from Deidara’s explosive clay, Gaara uses his chakra to create a giant sand shield.

episodes.title: Run, Kankuro
episodes.synopsis: Gaara, his strength completely exhausted, is whisked away by Deidara. Kankuro ignores Baki’s efforts to stop him and immediately sets out in pursuit with a platoon to rescue Gaara.

episodes.title: Team Kakashi, Deployed
episodes.synopsis: An urgent message from the Sand Village detailing the Akatsuki’s kidnapping of the Kazekage reaches the Hidden Leaf Village. Tsunade wastes no time in ordering Team Kakashi to the Sand Village.

episodes.title: The Jinchuriki's Tears
episodes.synopsis: On her way to the Sand Village, Temari encounters Kakashi and his team. Kakashi admonishes Naruto when he tries to rush ahead…

episodes.title: Sealing Jutsu: Nine Phantom Dragons
episodes.synopsis: The Sand ninja fight against time to treat Kankuro. Even the Sand’s poison expert, Granny Chiyo, is baffled. The only hope lies with the reinforcements sent by Tsunade.

episodes.title: The Medical Ninja's Student
episodes.synopsis: Sakura treats a critically ill Kankuro. After extensive training she’s now a full-fledged Medic Ninja, and Sakura amazes everyone with her sure, steady hands.

episodes.title: The Retired Granny's Determination
episodes.synopsis: Pakkun finds the hideout of the Akatsuki. Team Kakashi and Temari prepare to set out to get Gaara back, but Temari is ordered to stay behind and help guard the village.

episodes.title: A Meeting With Destiny
episodes.synopsis: Team Kakashi encounter Itachi Uchiha, who had dealt them a bitter defeat in the past. Kakashi warns everyone not to look into Itachi’s Sharingan Eyes.

episodes.title: Naruto's Growth
episodes.synopsis: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

episodes.title: The Secret Weapon is Called....
episodes.synopsis: Granny Chiyo and Sakura rescue Naruto from Itachi’s genjutsu. Without a moment’s delay, Kakashi begins a counterattack.

episodes.title: The Secret of Jinchuriki
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo and Kakashi realize that the attack was just a diversion, and that the Akatsuki have already begun the process of extracting the Tailed Beast from Gaara.

episodes.title: The Death of Gaara!
episodes.synopsis: Teams Kakashi and Guy take a short rest. Granny Chiyo watches Naruto dozing off and is reminded of Sasori as a child. The pursuit resumes, and when Chiyo wonders why Naruto puts such effort into rescuing Gaara…

episodes.title: Charge Tactic! Button Hook Entry!!
episodes.synopsis: Teams Kakashi and Guy reach the Akatsuki hideout. They hurry to infiltrate but are thwarted by a five-seal barrier. The only way to break the barrier is to remove all five seals at once.

episodes.title: Traps Activate! Team Guy's Enemy
episodes.synopsis: Breaking the five-seal barrier set off a trap, which now has Team Guy battling amazingly accurate copies of themselves. Back at the Akatsuki hideout, Deidara and Sasori struggle to take the Nine-Tail Jinchûriki.

episodes.title: Hiruko vs. Two Kunoichi!
episodes.synopsis: At last, the showdown between the old woman and her grandson begins. Sakura is confused by Sasori’s strange appearance, and Granny Chiyo explains that this is Hiruko…

episodes.title: Sasori's Real Face
episodes.synopsis: Granny Chiyo and Sakura manage to expose Sasori, who amazingly looks no older than he did twenty years earlier. Chiyo is even more shocked at the second puppet that Sasori produces.

episodes.title: Chiyo's Secret Skills
episodes.synopsis: Sakura is caught by Sasori’s tactic and surrounded by a poison cloud. But she uses a Paper Bomb to blow herself free from the poisonous fumes.

episodes.title: Father and Mother
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo and Sakura take cover, and Sasori wastes no time unleashing a ruthless attack. Chiyo fights back to protect Sakura, but in an instant the Father and Mother puppets are sealed by the Iron Sand.

episodes.title: The Third Kazekage
episodes.synopsis: Sakura counters the Iron Sand attack of the Third Kazekage puppet with superhuman strength. She learned from Tsunade that the most important skill of a Medic Ninja is the ability to evade an attack.

episodes.title: Three Minutes Between Life and Death
episodes.synopsis: Sakura destroys the Third Kazekage puppet thanks to a secret antidote she had taken. Sakuro explains to a surprised Granny Chiyo that this antidote converts the poison into harmless protein and is effective for about three minutes.

episodes.title: Puppet Fight: 10 vs. 100!
episodes.synopsis: Sakura and Granny Chiyo are engaged in a fierce battle with Sasori, who is able turn himself into a human puppet. They somehow bring Sasori down within the time limit, but he ends up reviving.

episodes.title: Impossible Dream
episodes.synopsis: Although stung with poison herself, Granny Chiyo uses the last of the antidote on Sakura. Mocking the tender scene between Granny Chiyo and Sakura, Sasori attempts to end Granny Chiyo's life.

episodes.title: Beasts: Alive Again!
episodes.synopsis: Team Guy senses the result of the Sakura and Granny Chiyo’s desperate struggle while still in battle with his deadly copy. Although Guy’s team members are showing fatigue, their copies remain strong!

episodes.title: Kakashi Enlightened!
episodes.synopsis: Sakura hurries to get to Naruto with Granny Chiyo, who is suffering from the poison. The members of Team Guy rush to assist Team Kakashi. Meanwhile, with all preparations complete, Kakashi reveals his Mangekyo Sharingan.

episodes.title: Aesthetics of an Instant
episodes.synopsis: Naruto loses all reason to anger and is gradually taken over by the Nine-Tailed Fox Spirit. Having been forewarned by Jiraiya, Kakashi narrowly manages to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox.

episodes.title: The Legacy
episodes.synopsis: Relying on Naruto's power, Granny Chiyo performs the Transmigration Jutsu on Gaara. Sakura is saddened when she realizes the cost of this jutsu.

episodes.title: Return of the Kazekage
episodes.synopsis: Gaara and his rescuers make a triumphant return to the Hidden Sand Village. After paying their respects at Granny Chiyo's grave, Naruto and the Leaf ninja reluctantly take their leave.

episodes.title: The New Target
episodes.synopsis: Everyone has returned to the Hidden Leaf Village. Kakashi is hospitalized for a week due to the strain caused by his Mangekyo Sharingan.

episodes.title: Formation! New Team Kakashi!
episodes.synopsis: After attacking Naruto, Sai predicts that they will meet again soon, then vanishes. Tsunade meets with the village elders, Homura and Koharu…

episodes.title: An Unnecessary Addition
episodes.synopsis: Naruto is enraged when he discovers that Sai attacked him in order to test his strength. Sakura pulls them apart, but tensions are running high between the members of Team Kakashi.

episodes.title: The Fake Smile
episodes.synopsis: The new Team Kakashi heads for Tenchikyo. To Naruto, Sai is just temporarily filling in for Sasuke. When Sai shows his contempt for Sasuke, the antagonism comes to a head.

episodes.title: Untitled
episodes.synopsis: Sakura comes across Sai working on an abstract painting. He tells her that he's unable to give it a title. Bothered by his manner, Sakura finds an unusual picture book among Sai's things.

episodes.title: Simulation
episodes.synopsis: In preparation for Tenchikyo, Yamato conducts a half-day simulation in order to get a grasp on the fighting skills and jutsu of Team Kakashi. Sai abandons Naruto to conclude the simulated mission successfully.

episodes.title: The Tenchi Bridge
episodes.synopsis: The day for capturing the spy is finally here. Just as planned, Yamato takes on Sasori's likeness and waits until the Akatsuki spy appears. The spy turns out to be none other than Kabuto.

episodes.title: The Nine-Tails Unleashed
episodes.synopsis: Faced with Orochimaru, his sworn enemy, Naruto suddenly releases the power of his Nine-Tailed Fox. When Yamato sees Naruto's fourth tail appear, he recalls Jiraiya's tale of how he nearly lost his life to the transformed Naruto.

episodes.title: The Top-Secret Mission Begins
episodes.synopsis: When his third tail appears, all that Naruto can see is Orochimaru. He is blind even to his teammates.

episodes.title: Orochimaru vs. Jinchuriki
episodes.synopsis: With the release of his fourth tail, Naruto completely loses his awareness and is overtaken by destructive impulses.

episodes.title: Sakura's Tears
episodes.synopsis: Although he has changed almost completely into his animal form and has lost all awareness, Naruto refuses to give up the idea of bringing Sasuke home.

episodes.title: The Secret of the Battle!
episodes.synopsis: Taking advantage of the confusion, Sai makes contact with Orochimaru. After reviewing the contents of the documents given to him, Orochimaru decides to take Sai back to the hideout.

episodes.title: The Consequences of Betrayal
episodes.synopsis: Naruto and Sakura are shocked when they hear that Danzo's goal is to work with Orochimaru to once again attempt to defeat the Leaf Village.

episodes.title: The Unfinished Page
episodes.synopsis: Naruto is shocked to learn that he was the one responsible for the destruction around them and for Sakura's injuries.

episodes.title: Infiltration: The Den of the Snake!
episodes.synopsis: Sai shudders when he finally meets Sasuke face to face in Orochimaru's hideout. The list that Sai gave to Orochimaru lists the members of the Anbu Black Ops, the corps under the direct control of the Hokage.

episodes.title: Bonds
episodes.synopsis: Team Kakashi is able to find Sai with Yamato guiding them. They immediately begin questioning Sai about Danzo's plans for destroying the Leaf Village, and surprisingly, Sai divulges everything.

episodes.title: Something Important...
episodes.synopsis: Kabuto carries out a surprise attack on Team Kakashi to take back Sai, but a change has come over Sai since Sakura pointed out his contradictions.

episodes.title: The Picture Book's Story
episodes.synopsis: Naruto, while nursing his injuries caused by the release of the Nine-Tailed Fox, searches frantically for Sasuke. Seeing this, Sai recalls the feelings he once had for his older brother and finally manages to complete his unfinished picture.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Team Kakashi are stunned to learn that Sai's true mission is to kill Sasuke. Naruto wants to believe that the smile Sai showed them was real, but there is a possibility that it was all an act.

episodes.title: The Power of Uchiha
episodes.synopsis: Team Kakashi finally have their wish to be reunited with Sasuke granted. Although it has been three long years, Sasuke's feelings have not changed. His ultimate goal is to get revenge against his older brother, Itachi.

episodes.title: Title
episodes.synopsis: Sasuke's desire for revenge remains firm, no matter how hard Naruto tries to talk him out of it. Yamato tries to take Sasuke by force, but interference by Orochimaru brings things to a quick close.
